name: Aura of Evasion

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: You and allies in a 30-foot Emanation have Advantage on Dexterity saves. Against Dexterity saves for half damage, success deals none and failure deals half. Incapacitated creatures receive no benefit.
